programme.title: Irma La Douce
programme.desc: Set in Paris' famous Red Light district, a rookie policeman (Jack Lemmon) plots to keep a beautiful prostitute (Shirley MacLaine) all to himself in this hit comedy from director Billy Wilder.

programme.title: Kiss Me, Stupid
programme.desc: In this comic gem from the legendary Billy Wilder and his long-time writing partner I.A.L. Diamond, Dean Martin is a famous singer targeted by two would-be songwriters who encourage a waitress (Kim Novak) to coerce Dino into a song-buying mood.

programme.title: The Fortune Cookie
programme.desc: In their very first screen pairing, Walter Matthau (who would win a Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his performance) and Jack Lemmon portray a crooked lawyer and his TV cameraman brother-in-law in this madcap tale of greed and recouping lost love.

programme.title: Braveheart
programme.desc: William Wallace, a commoner, unites the 13th Century Scots in their battle to overthrow English rule.

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death”.

programme.title: The Ruins
programme.desc: "The Ruins" follows a group of friends who become entangled in a struggle for survival after visiting a remote archaeological dig in the Mexican jungle where they discover something deadly living among the ruins.

programme.title: Escape Room
programme.desc: For a birthday celebration, three couples partake in an ESCAPE ROOM, in which they must work together to solve puzzles in order to escape the room—but when the game turns deadly, they quickly learn the only winners are the survivors.

programme.title: Prowl
programme.desc: A group of friends on their way to the big city are terrorized in an abandoned warehouse where bloodthirsty creatures hunt human prey.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: As the entire nation watches the presidential campaign hurtle towards Election Day, one soldier races to uncover the conspiracy behind it - a conspiracy that seeks to destroy democracy itself.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: When straight arrow FBI agent Roy Clayton (Guy Pearce of MOMENTO) heads up the investigation into a dangerous international conspiracy, all clues seem to lead back to former U.S. Special Operations officer, Samir Horn (Don Cheadle of CRASH).

programme.title: The Grandmaster
programme.desc: From director Wong Kar Wai and starring Tony Leung and Ziyi Yang, THE GRANDMASTER is an epic action film inspired by the life of Ip Man, the legendary kung fu master who trained Bruce Lee.

programme.title: The Guillotines
programme.desc: A secret brotherhood of assassins, once favored by the Emperor, is exiled and hunted with firearms that challenge the power of their cold steel.

programme.title: Sakra
programme.desc: Starring & directed by international action star Donnie Yen—When a respected martial artist is accused of murder, he goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origin story and the unknown enemies working to destroy him.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (2005)
programme.desc: The story of a pro quarterback and former college champion and coach are asked to put together a football team of inmates to take on the guards while doing their time in prison.

programme.title: Men in Black
programme.desc: Two top secret agents (Will Smith and Tommy Lee Jones) are on a mission of policing alien activities on planet Earth. The Men in Black's current assignment: to stop an intergalactic terrorist from making Earth his next victim.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Agents Jay and Kay are re-teamed against a sinister seductress who represents the toughest challenge yet to the MIB.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: Unforgettable and powerful, this winner of 9 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Best Director (Anthony Minghella) and Best Supporting Actress (Juliette Binoche) unfolds an incredible tale of passion, intrigue, and adventure.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Matt Damon plays Rudy Baylor, a rookie lawyer in over his head on a high-profile case. Opposing him: an army of legal sharks. On Rudy’s side: Deck Shifflet, a feisty “paralawyer” who specializes in flunking the bar exam.

programme.title: Along Came A Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Disturbia
programme.desc: Living under three months' house arrest, Kale Brecht (Shia LaBeouf, Transformers) passes his days spying on the neighbors. It's all fun and games until things take a horrifying turn for the worse.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar Gilkyson (Robert Redford) lives on a Wyoming ranch with his only friend, Mitch (Morgan Freeman). Then, suddenly, the woman he blames for his son's death arrives at his door broke, desperate, and with a granddaughter he's never known.

programme.title: Allied
programme.desc: When Intelligence Officer Max Vatan (Brad Pitt) learns his wife (Academy Award winner Marion Cotillard) may be conspiring with the enemy, he has only 72 hours to prove her innocence and save his family before he must do the unthinkable.

programme.title: Rancho Deluxe
programme.desc: Jack (Jeff Bridges) and Cecil (Sam Waterston) are an oddball team of modern-day Montana cattle rustlers, and they’ve set their sights on a pair of unlikely ranch owners from New York (Clifton James, Elizabeth Ashley). But can they outfox the foxes?

programme.title: Cattle Annie And Little Britches
programme.desc: Two young aspiring outlaws (Amanda Plummer and Diane Lane) manage to join what’s left of the Doolin-Dalton gang, led by the aging Bill Doolin (Burt Lancaster). The gang’s heyday may be far behind them, but there’s still plenty of adventure left!

programme.title: The White Buffalo
programme.desc: Charles Bronson and Will Sampson star as Wild Bill Hickok and Chief Crazy Horse in this one-of-a-kind western that finds both western legends braving the snowy wilderness in search of the demon that haunts them both, the fabled White Buffalo!

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
programme.desc: When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

programme.title: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves
programme.desc: A charming thief and a band of unlikely adventurers undertake an epic heist to retrieve a lost relic. Still, things go dangerously awry when they run afoul of the wrong people in this hilarious and action-packed adventure.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: A.I. Artificial Intelligence

programme.title: Kiss Me, Stupid
programme.desc: In this comic gem from the legendary Billy Wilder and his long-time writing partner I.A.L. Diamond, Dean Martin is a famous singer targeted by two would-be songwriters who encourage a waitress (Kim Novak) to coerce Dino into a song-buying mood.

programme.title: The Fortune Cookie
programme.desc: In their very first screen pairing, Walter Matthau (who would win a Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his performance) and Jack Lemmon portray a crooked lawyer and his TV cameraman brother-in-law in this madcap tale of greed and recouping lost love.

programme.title: The Private Life Of Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: When a beautiful woman claims that her husband has disappeared, the investigation takes Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson to Scotland, where they uncover a plot involving a clandestine society, Her Majesty's Secret Service... and the Loch Ness Monster!

programme.title: Gladiator
programme.desc: A man robbed of his name and his dignity strives to win them back, and gain the freedom of his people, in this epic historical drama from director Ridley Scott.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death”.

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: The target: a missile depot in Hanoi. The plane: the A-6 Intruder, a low-altitude bomber with no defensive weapons. The risk: court-martial at the hands of Commander Camparelli...if they live to return.

programme.title: Prowl
programme.desc: A group of friends on their way to the big city are terrorized in an abandoned warehouse where bloodthirsty creatures hunt human prey.

programme.title: Feast
programme.desc: Customers locked inside a bar are forced to fight monsters.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers
programme.desc: After making a horrific discovery in the basement of a old church, Trish and her brother Darry watch their routine road trip home turn into a heart stopping race for their lives. They are now the chosen prey of a force that relentlessly pursues them.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: The Creeper terrorizes a group of varsity basketball players, cheerleaders and coaches who are stranded on a highway after their bus breaks down. Fighting their own fears and prejudices the group of athletes are forced to come together to stay alive.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: Traitor
programme.desc: When straight arrow FBI agent Roy Clayton (Guy Pearce of MOMENTO) heads up the investigation into a dangerous international conspiracy, all clues seem to lead back to former U.S. Special Operations officer, Samir Horn (Don Cheadle of CRASH).

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: As the entire nation watches the presidential campaign hurtle towards Election Day, one soldier races to uncover the conspiracy behind it - a conspiracy that seeks to destroy democracy itself.

programme.title: Sakra
programme.desc: Starring & directed by international action star Donnie Yen—When a respected martial artist is accused of murder, he goes on the run in search of answers about his own mysterious origin story and the unknown enemies working to destroy him.

programme.title: The Foreigner
programme.desc: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism.

programme.title: Tekken
programme.desc: The year is 2039. The world wars have destroyed everything, and territories are run by corporations, the mightiest of which is TEKKEN. In the midst of the ruined society, one warrior rises from the streets.

programme.title: Men in Black II
programme.desc: Agents Jay and Kay are re-teamed against a sinister seductress who represents the toughest challenge yet to the MIB.

programme.title: Men in Black³
programme.desc: Agent Jay travels back in time to 1969, where he teams up with a younger version of Agent Kay to stop an evil alien from destroying the future.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (2005)
programme.desc: The story of a pro quarterback and former college champion and coach are asked to put together a football team of inmates to take on the guards while doing their time in prison.

programme.title: The English Patient
programme.desc: Unforgettable and powerful, this winner of 9 Academy Awards, including Best Picture, Best Director (Anthony Minghella) and Best Supporting Actress (Juliette Binoche) unfolds an incredible tale of passion, intrigue, and adventure.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Along Came A Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Disturbia
programme.desc: Living under three months' house arrest, Kale Brecht (Shia LaBeouf, Transformers) passes his days spying on the neighbors. It's all fun and games until things take a horrifying turn for the worse.

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Matt Damon plays Rudy Baylor, a rookie lawyer in over his head on a high-profile case. Opposing him: an army of legal sharks. On Rudy’s side: Deck Shifflet, a feisty “paralawyer” who specializes in flunking the bar exam.

programme.title: Allied
programme.desc: When Intelligence Officer Max Vatan (Brad Pitt) learns his wife (Academy Award winner Marion Cotillard) may be conspiring with the enemy, he has only 72 hours to prove her innocence and save his family before he must do the unthinkable.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar Gilkyson (Robert Redford) lives on a Wyoming ranch with his only friend, Mitch (Morgan Freeman). Then, suddenly, the woman he blames for his son's death arrives at his door broke, desperate, and with a granddaughter he's never known.

programme.title: The White Buffalo
programme.desc: Charles Bronson and Will Sampson star as Wild Bill Hickok and Chief Crazy Horse in this one-of-a-kind western that finds both western legends braving the snowy wilderness in search of the demon that haunts them both, the fabled White Buffalo!

programme.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
programme.desc: When his wife is killed, Marshal Chris Adams (Lee Van Cleef) discovers that a ruthless horde of marauders have killed all the men -- and will come back for the women -- in a nearby border town...unless The Magnificent Seven can stop them!

programme.title: Return Of The Seven
programme.desc: Starring Yul Brynner and a stellar supporting cast that includes Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins, this classic western adventure follows the legendary Magnificent Seven as they thunder through Mexico to face the shootout of their lives!

programme.title: The Shootist
programme.desc: Afflicted with a terminal illness, John Bernard Books, the last of the legendary gunfighters, quietly returns to Carson City for medical attention from his old friend Dr. Hostetler.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Swiss Army Man
programme.desc: Hank (Paul Dano) is stranded on a deserted island and given up all hope. Everything changes when a corpse (Daniel Radcliffe) washes ashore. They become fast friends and go on an epic adventure to bring Hank back to the woman of his dreams.

programme.title: RV (2006)
programme.desc: A forced family vacation in a recreational vehicle rapidly turns into a disaster.

programme.title: Snack Shack
programme.desc: In Nebraska City, 1991, two best friends get the chance to run the swimming pool snack shack, which later becomes the perfect setting for transgression, fun, personal discovery, and romance.

programme.title: DOA: Dead or Alive
programme.desc: The world's best fighters are invited to DOA, a martial-arts tournament. Four female rival fighters, an aristocratic warrior, a wrestling superstar, an athlete with a tragic past, and an assassin-for-hire, work together to uncover a secret.

programme.title: I Think We're Alone Now
programme.desc: The carefully crafted paradise of the last man on Earth is threatened by the arrival of a mysterious interloper.

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: Rainn Wilson, Elliot Page, Liv Tyler, and Kevin Bacon bring to life this super-entertaining action fantasy about a regular joe turned homegrown masked avenger.

programme.title: Knights of Badassdom
programme.desc: Live-action role players conjure up a demon from Hell by mistake and they must deal with the consequences.

programme.title: We Summon the Darkness
programme.desc: A post-concert party at a remote country mansion turns into a grisly satanic slaughter scene in this dark-humored horror-thriller starring Alexandra Daddario and Johnny Knoxville.

programme.title: Hex
programme.desc: Following a mysterious disappearance on a jump, a group of skydivers experience paranormal occurrences that leave them fighting for their lives.

programme.title: Prey (2007)
programme.desc: While on holiday, an Amerian family are trapped by hungry lions in South Africa.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

programme.title: Breakin' 2: Electric Boogaloo
programme.desc: The beat doesn't slow down in this slammin' sequel to "Breakin'.'" This fly follow-up finds our poppin' and lockin' trio Kelly, Ozone and Turbo trying to rescue a community center facing demolition at the hands of a greedy real-estate developer.

programme.title: Purple Rain
programme.desc: Rock star Prince makes a spectacular feature film debut in this highly autobiographical blockbuster that won both an Oscar and a Grammy award.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father Dusty (Wahlberg) shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: Shottas
programme.desc: Two young men from Jamaica climb to the top of the criminal world in Miami, with a constant presence of drugs, extortion, and deceit.

programme.title: Revolver
programme.desc: REVOLVER is populated with Guy Ritchie's (Snatch; Lock, Stock & Two Smoking Barrels) classic breed of fast-talking, sharp-suited gangsters but with a psychological twist that your mind may not be able to handle.

programme.title: Better Luck Tomorrow
programme.desc: To his classmates and teachers, high-schooler Ben Manibag appears to be the model student: a perfectionist and overachiever. But underneath this persona is a darker side. Ben and his bored high-school buddies lead double lives.

programme.title: In & Out

programme.title: The Fortune Cookie
programme.desc: In their very first screen pairing, Walter Matthau (who would win a Best Supporting Actor Oscar for his performance) and Jack Lemmon portray a crooked lawyer and his TV cameraman brother-in-law in this madcap tale of greed and recouping lost love.

programme.title: The Private Life Of Sherlock Holmes
programme.desc: When a beautiful woman claims that her husband has disappeared, the investigation takes Sherlock Holmes and Dr. Watson to Scotland, where they uncover a plot involving a clandestine society, Her Majesty's Secret Service... and the Loch Ness Monster!

programme.title: Sabrina (1954)
programme.desc: Bogie and Holden are the mega-rich Larrabee brothers of Long Island. Bogie’s all work, Holden’s all playboy. But when Sabrina (Hepburn), daughter of the family’s chauffeur, returns from Paris, the stage is set for some family fireworks.

programme.title: We Were Soldiers
programme.desc: In 1965, America is at war with North Vietnam and Lt. Col. Hal Moore prepares his troops for one of the most violent battles in U.S. History: “The Valley of Death”.

programme.title: Flight of the Intruder
programme.desc: The target: a missile depot in Hanoi. The plane: the A-6 Intruder, a low-altitude bomber with no defensive weapons. The risk: court-martial at the hands of Commander Camparelli...if they live to return.

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Jeepers Creepers 2
programme.desc: The Creeper terrorizes a group of varsity basketball players, cheerleaders and coaches who are stranded on a highway after their bus breaks down. Fighting their own fears and prejudices the group of athletes are forced to come together to stay alive.

programme.title: Stigmata
programme.desc: A priest from the Vatican is sent to visit a woman who's showing signs of stigmata. The priest comes to find that the lady is truly possessed by something.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: After an accident on a winding road, four teens make the fatal mistake of dumping their victim's body into the sea. But exactly one year later, the dead man returns from his watery grave, and he's looking for more than an apology.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: As the entire nation watches the presidential campaign hurtle towards Election Day, one soldier races to uncover the conspiracy behind it - a conspiracy that seeks to destroy democracy itself.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal gun battle, Marcus recalls his journey from orphaned street kid from the Bronx to making his mark in the drug trade to teaming up with a fellow ex-con (Terrence Howard) for his shot at becoming a successful rap artist.

programme.title: Tekken
programme.desc: The year is 2039. The world wars have destroyed everything, and territories are run by corporations, the mightiest of which is TEKKEN. In the midst of the ruined society, one warrior rises from the streets.

programme.title: 7 Assassins
programme.desc: When gold goes missing in ancient China, royal guards entrusted with its recovery realize they are not the only people in pursuit.

programme.title: Dragon
programme.desc: Liu Jin-xi (Donnie Yen) is a village craftsman whose quiet life is irrevocably shattered by the arrival of two notorious gangsters in the local general store.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (2005)
programme.desc: The story of a pro quarterback and former college champion and coach are asked to put together a football team of inmates to take on the guards while doing their time in prison.

programme.title: Here Comes the Boom
programme.desc: A biology teacher takes up fighting in mixed martial arts matches to raise money to save the school's music program.

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: When a harried workaholic is given a universal remote that allows him to pause, rewind, or skip past portions of his life, he discovers which parts are truly the best of his life.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A man tries to transport an ancient gun called The Mexican, believed to carry a curse, back across the border, while his girlfriend pressures him to give up his criminal ways.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: John Grisham's The Rainmaker
programme.desc: Matt Damon plays Rudy Baylor, a rookie lawyer in over his head on a high-profile case. Opposing him: an army of legal sharks. On Rudy’s side: Deck Shifflet, a feisty “paralawyer” who specializes in flunking the bar exam.

programme.title: Along Came A Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Disturbia
programme.desc: Living under three months' house arrest, Kale Brecht (Shia LaBeouf, Transformers) passes his days spying on the neighbors. It's all fun and games until things take a horrifying turn for the worse.

programme.title: The Wolf of Wall Street
programme.desc: Sex. Money. Power. Drugs. Brace yourself for a true story from legendary filmmaker Martin Scorsese. Leonardo DiCaprio stars as a young stockbroker hungry for a life of non-stop thrills, where corruption was king and more was never enough.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar Gilkyson (Robert Redford) lives on a Wyoming ranch with his only friend, Mitch (Morgan Freeman). Then, suddenly, the woman he blames for his son's death arrives at his door broke, desperate, and with a granddaughter he's never known.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: Return Of The Seven
programme.desc: Starring Yul Brynner and a stellar supporting cast that includes Robert Fuller, Warren Oates and Claude Akins, this classic western adventure follows the legendary Magnificent Seven as they thunder through Mexico to face the shootout of their lives!

programme.title: The Shootist
programme.desc: Afflicted with a terminal illness, John Bernard Books, the last of the legendary gunfighters, quietly returns to Carson City for medical attention from his old friend Dr. Hostetler.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: Ribald, tasteless and hilarious ... this classic spoof of the Western genre by director Mel Brooks pokes fun at everyone and everything.

programme.title: Young Guns
programme.desc: In a lawless and violent time, six young outcasts are hired by an English merchant as 'regulators' to guard his ranch against the mob, a corrupt and powerful ring.

programme.title: Transformers: Dark of the Moon
programme.desc: A mysterious event from Earth's past threatens to ignite a war so big that the Transformers alone will not be able to save the planet. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must fight against the darkness to defend our world from the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers
programme.desc: From director Michael Bay and executive producer Steven Spielberg comes a thrilling battle between the heroic Autobots and the evil Decepticons. When their epic struggle comes to Earth, Sam Witwicky becomes mankind's last chance for survival.

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen
programme.desc: The battle for Earth continues when college-bound Sam Witwicky learns the truth about the ancient origins of the Transformers and must join in their continued battle against the Decepticons.

programme.title: Snack Shack
programme.desc: In Nebraska City, 1991, two best friends get the chance to run the swimming pool snack shack, which later becomes the perfect setting for transgression, fun, personal discovery, and romance.

programme.title: The Guilt Trip
programme.desc: "Barbra Streisand and Seth Rogen are the perfect comedy duo"* as they embark on one mother of a road trip! When Andy invites his mom on an 8-day, 3,000-mile journey across the country, the farther they go, the closer they get. *Jake Hamilton, FOX-TV

programme.title: Legally Blonde
programme.desc: Elle Woods has it all, but when her boyfriend goes to Harvard, Ellie rallies all her resources to get into Harvard Law. But law school is a far cry from the comforts of home. Elle must wage the battle of her life, for herself and for all blondes!

programme.title: Super
programme.desc: Rainn Wilson, Elliot Page, Liv Tyler, and Kevin Bacon bring to life this super-entertaining action fantasy about a regular joe turned homegrown masked avenger.

programme.title: Knights of Badassdom
programme.desc: Live-action role players conjure up a demon from Hell by mistake and they must deal with the consequences.

programme.title: I Think We're Alone Now
programme.desc: The carefully crafted paradise of the last man on Earth is threatened by the arrival of a mysterious interloper.

programme.title: Prey (2007)
programme.desc: While on holiday, an Amerian family are trapped by hungry lions in South Africa.

programme.title: Let Me In
programme.desc: Owen, an overlooked and bullied boy, finds love and revenge through Abby (Chloë Grace Moretz of KICK-ASS), a beautiful but peculiar girl who turns out to be a vampire.

programme.title: Hell House LLC.
programme.desc: Five years after an unexplained malfunction causes the death of 15 tour-goers and staff on the opening night of a Halloween haunted house tour, a documentary crew travels back to the scene of the tragedy to find out what really happened.

programme.title: Pet Sematary
programme.desc: Based on the terrifying novel by Stephen King... After the Creed family moves to rural Maine, they stumble upon an ancient burial ground with sinister powers. When tragedy strikes, a perilous chain of events unleashes an unfathomable evil.

programme.title: Footloose
programme.desc: A rebellious city boy finds himself in an uptight Midwestern town where dancing and therefore all youthful joy has been banned.

programme.title: Terms of Endearment
programme.desc: Terms of Endearment dazzled critics and audiences alike with its believable, insightful story of two captivating people, mother and daughter, unforgettably played by Shirley MacLaine and Debra Winger.

programme.title: Ferris Bueller's Day Off
programme.desc: High school senior, Ferris Bueller, decides to cut school and is determined to experience a day of pure freedom with his girlfriend and best friend in downtown Chicago before graduating.

programme.title: Wayne's World 2
programme.desc: Having achieved godlike status as a late-night TV personality, Wayne now confronts the question that has plagued man for centuries: Is there life after cable?

programme.title: Evolution
programme.desc: A firefighting cadet, two college professors, and a geeky-but-sexy government scientist work against an alien organism that has been rapidly evolving ever since its arrival on Earth inside a meteor.

programme.title: Daddy's Home
programme.desc: Will Ferrell & Mark Wahlberg face off in this Dad vs Step-Dad showdown! Brad (Ferrell) wants to be the best step-dad to his new wife's kids. But when their actual father Dusty (Wahlberg) shows up, the two must go toe-to-toe in this fun family comedy.

programme.title: Better Luck Tomorrow
programme.desc: To his classmates and teachers, high-schooler Ben Manibag appears to be the model student: a perfectionist and overachiever. But underneath this persona is a darker side. Ben and his bored high-school buddies lead double lives.

programme.title: Witness
programme.desc: When a young Amish woman and her son get caught up in the murder of an undercover narcotic's agent, their saviour turns out to be hardened Philadelphia detective John Book.

programme.title: Safe
programme.desc: A cage fighter struggling to deal with a tragic loss comes to the rescue of a Chinese girl being targeted by the Russian mafia. He vows to help her and sets out to uncover the truth behind her connection to the gangsters.

programme.title: Nacho Libre
programme.desc: Jack Black is more hilarious than ever as Ignacio, a monastery cook who feeds orphan children by day and by night transforms himself into Nacho Libre, a notorious Luchador in stretchy pants.

programme.title: Coneheads
programme.desc: One look, and you know they're from a very strange place. They're from New Jersey, by way of France, by way of far-off, far-out Remulak. They're Coneheads.

programme.title: In & Out
programme.desc: A former student who's now an actor tells an audience of millions that Howard is gay. He's outed when he didn't know he was in! Kevin Kline plays Howard, scrambling to go forth with his wedding and doing his best to assert his manliness.

programme.title: Harriet the Spy
programme.desc: Harriet M. Welsch is probably the world’s most accomplished 11-year-old spy. Harriet dreams of being a writer, and her nanny and best friend, Golly, told her to start by writing down everything she sees.

programme.title: South Park: Bigger, Longer & Uncut
programme.desc: Stan, Kyle, Kenny and Cartman sneak into an R-rated movie that warps their fragile minds. Soon their parents declare war on Canada and the guys are America's last hope to stop Armageddon.

programme.title: Wayne's World
programme.desc: When a sleazy TV exec offers Wayne and Garth a contract to tape their late-night cable-access show at his network, they discover the road to the big time is full of gnarly twists and turns.

programme.title: Chato's Land
programme.desc: Chato, a half-Apache horseman, is on the run from a blood-thirsty posse led by an ex-Confederate officer, who is determined to see him dead. Eventually, the pursued and the pursuers will become reversed, thanks to the unforgiving, cruel desert.

programme.title: North Dallas Forty
programme.desc: In a society in which major league sporting events have replaced Sunday worship as the religion of choice, North Dallas Forty appears like a desecration at the altar.

programme.title: The Big Bus

programme.title: Sabrina (1954)

programme.title: Funny Face
programme.desc: Paris, the City of Light, shines even brighter when Audrey Hepburn and Fred Astaire team up for the only time and bring their luminous starpower to this exquisite musical featuring songs by George and Ira Gershwin.

programme.title: Charade
programme.desc: Romance and suspense ensue in Paris as a woman is pursued by several men who want a fortune her murdered husband had stolen. Whom can she trust?

programme.title: Saving Private Ryan
programme.desc: A World War II captain (Tom Hanks) and his squad (Edward Burns, Tom Sizemore) risk all to locate and send home a soldier whose three brothers died in combat.

programme.title: Crank
programme.desc: Today is the last day of hit man Chev Chelios' life. He has been given a poison that will kill him if he allows his heart to settle into a normal rhythm. In order to stay alive and take revenge, Chev must keep his adrenaline elevated by any way possible.

programme.title: Stigmata
programme.desc: A priest from the Vatican is sent to visit a woman who's showing signs of stigmata. The priest comes to find that the lady is truly possessed by something.

programme.title: I Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: After an accident on a winding road, four teens make the fatal mistake of dumping their victim's body into the sea. But exactly one year later, the dead man returns from his watery grave, and he's looking for more than an apology.

programme.title: I Still Know What You Did Last Summer
programme.desc: Remember Ben Willis? He's the fisherman who killed the boy who was driving the car when it went off the road in the fatal accident that killed his daughter, Sara... he's the man in the slicker with a hook in his hand... well, he's back.

programme.title: Gemini Man
programme.desc: Will Smith stars in the nonstop action thrill-ride from Academy Award®-winning director Ang Lee. Retired hitman (Smith) is forced on the run and finds himself hunted by his ultimate adversary - a younger clone of himself.

programme.title: Get Rich or Die Tryin'
programme.desc: Following a near-fatal gun battle, Marcus recalls his journey from orphaned street kid from the Bronx to making his mark in the drug trade to teaming up with a fellow ex-con (Terrence Howard) for his shot at becoming a successful rap artist.

programme.title: Hustle & Flow
programme.desc: The tale of DJay, a pimp whose hustle selling sexy Nola leaves him wondering if this is it for him. Only when he trades contraband for a keyboard and bumps into his old schoolfriend Key does he see a way out by laying down some tracks.

programme.title: Dragon
programme.desc: Liu Jin-xi (Donnie Yen) is a village craftsman whose quiet life is irrevocably shattered by the arrival of two notorious gangsters in the local general store.

programme.title: Kill Zone
programme.desc: An inspector and his unit are after a crime boss and are willing to capture him at all costs. The crime boss enlists his top henchmen to end their dirty schemes.

programme.title: Man Of Tai Chi
programme.desc: Keanu Reeves makes his directorial debut in this explosive martial arts drama that reunites him with legendary Matrix Trilogy fight choreographer Yuen Wo Ping and stuntman Tiger Chen.

programme.title: Here Comes the Boom
programme.desc: A biology teacher takes up fighting in mixed martial arts matches to raise money to save the school's music program.

programme.title: Click
programme.desc: When a harried workaholic is given a universal remote that allows him to pause, rewind, or skip past portions of his life, he discovers which parts are truly the best of his life.

programme.title: The Longest Yard (2005)
programme.desc: The story of a pro quarterback and former college champion and coach are asked to put together a football team of inmates to take on the guards while doing their time in prison.

programme.title: The Mexican
programme.desc: A man tries to transport an ancient gun called The Mexican, believed to carry a curse, back across the border, while his girlfriend pressures him to give up his criminal ways.

programme.title: Vanilla Sky
programme.desc: Young and wealthy, David can have anything his heart desires. But his life seems incomplete. One night, David meets the woman of his dreams and believes he may have found the missing piece.

programme.title: Dreamland
programme.desc: Discovering a fugitive bank robber (Margot Robbie) is hiding in his small town, a young man is torn between claiming the bounty on her head and his growing attraction to the seductive criminal, in this epic love story set during the Great Depression.

programme.title: Along Came A Spider
programme.desc: After the harrowing death of his partner, detective and best-selling author Alex Cross has retreated to the peace of retirement. But when a brilliant criminal (Michael Wincott) kidnaps a senator’s young daughter, Alex is lured back into action.

programme.title: Disturbia
programme.desc: Living under three months' house arrest, Kale Brecht (Shia LaBeouf, Transformers) passes his days spying on the neighbors. It's all fun and games until things take a horrifying turn for the worse.

programme.title: Air Force One
programme.desc: When Russian neo-nationalists hijack Air Force One, the world's most secure aircraft, the President is faced with the decision to give in to terrorist demands or sacrifice the country's dignity and the lives of his wife and daughter.

programme.title: An Unfinished Life
programme.desc: Einar Gilkyson (Robert Redford) lives on a Wyoming ranch with his only friend, Mitch (Morgan Freeman). Then, suddenly, the woman he blames for his son's death arrives at his door broke, desperate, and with a granddaughter he's never known.

programme.title: Flags of Our Fathers
programme.desc: From Academy Award-winning director Clint Eastwood and Academy Award-winner Steven Spielberg, comes the life stories of the six men who raised the flag at The Battle of Iwo Jima, a turning point in WWII.

programme.title: Hamburger Hill
programme.desc: On the 11th May 1969, troops of the 101st airborne division engaged the enemy at the base of Hill 937 in the Ashau Valley. Ten days and eleven bloody assaults later, the troops who fought there called it Hamburger Hill.

programme.title: Blazing Saddles
programme.desc: Ribald, tasteless and hilarious ... this classic spoof of the Western genre by director Mel Brooks pokes fun at everyone and everything.

programme.title: Young Guns
programme.desc: In a lawless and violent time, six young outcasts are hired by an English merchant as 'regulators' to guard his ranch against the mob, a corrupt and powerful ring.

programme.title: Young Guns II
programme.desc: The West has changed since The Regulators last rode through. Cornered by the ruthless cattle kings and double-crossed by corrupt government officials, Billy the Kid leads the Regulators down a treacherous trail towards Old Mexico… and destiny.

programme.title: Transformers

programme.title: Transformers: Revenge of the Fallen

programme.desc: Now a rising lawyer, Elle Woods is about to make partner at her firm, she and Emmett are still love, and her hair is still healthy. Elle heads to D.C. and take matters into her own hands.

programme.title: I Think We're Alone Now

programme.desc: Winnie-The-Pooh: Blood and Honey follows Pooh and Piglet as they go on a rampage after Christopher Robin abandons them.

programme.title: Obsesión
programme.desc: Simon hereda una casa de campo a la que viaja con su familia. Su sueño es renovarla, pero cae en un romance prohibido. Ahora tendrá que estar dispuesta a llegar hasta las últimas consecuencias para recuperar su tranquilidad y a su familia.

programme.title: Age of reason

programme.title: Agora: la Caída del Imperio Romano
programme.desc: Drama histórico sobre un esclavo que se vuelve hacia la creciente ola del cristianismo con la esperanza de buscar la libertad mientras se enamora de su amante, la profesora de filosofía y matemáticas Hipatia de Alejandría.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Con el asesino aparentemente atrapado, el equipo cree que el caso está cerrado, cuando encuentran a otra mujer muerta que coincide con el m.o. del asesino en serie. Sarah, sin saberlo, se convierte en el objetivo del verdadero asesino.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Kane y su equipo SIU corren para encontrar al distribuidor de una píldora tóxica "E" que aumenta el número de muertos en Seattle y hace que el miembro temporal de SIU, Gates, se meta en una situación de vida o muerte.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: La investigación "E" se lleva a cabo sin problemas hasta que el principal jefe de Seattle P.D. ordenó a Kane que actuara como seguridad para un excéntrico documentalista.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: El equipo de Kane se enfrenta a la Nación Arian "Nueva Esperanza" ya que trabajan para influir en el voto del público en las elecciones municipales.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Kane, después de lidiar con su propio estrés de posguerra, está llamado a ayudar a su compañero de guerra (Ryan Robbins) mientras sufre de P.T.S.

programme.title: The Factory
programme.desc: Un policía obsesionado está tras la pista de un asesino en serie que merodea por las calles de Buffalo, Nueva York, pero cuando su hija adolescente desaparece, abandona cualquier restricción profesional para atrapar al asesino.

programme.title: El precio de la venganza
programme.desc: Cuando su hija es brutalmente asesinada y la justicia legal parece poco probable, William Duncan decide tomarse la justicia por su mano.

programme.title: Asesino íntimo
programme.desc: El detective Cristofuoro (Russell Crowe) investiga el asesinato de una familia y tiene que averiguar si el responsable es un adolescente violento.

programme.title: Una familia peligrosa
programme.desc: Un jefe de la mafia y su familia son trasladados a un pueblo tranquilo en Francia bajo el programa de protección de testigos después de delatar a la mafia.

programme.title: Alex Rider: Operación Stormbreaker
programme.desc: Después de la muerte de su tío, el colegial de 14 años Alex Rider es obligado por la División de Operaciones Especiales del servicio secreto de inteligencia del Reino Unido, MI6, a una misión que salvará millones de vidas.

programme.title: Wish Upon a Star
programme.desc: En este clásico culto, Hayley Wheaton (Danielle Harris) desea cambiar de lugar con su hermana, la mayor y más popular Alexia (Katherine Heigl). Tras una pelea entre las hermanas, ellas despiertan un día a ver que el sueño se ha hecho realidad.

programme.title: THE PERFECT GAME
programme.desc: Basado en una historia real. En 1957, un grupo de niños pobres de Monterrey, México, conmocionó al mundo al ganar 13 juegos seguidos y la Serie Mundial de Pequeñas Ligas en el único juego perfecto jamás lanzado en el Campeonato.

programme.title: Coraje para Ganar
programme.desc: Después de perder a su padre, una joven debe encontrar la fuerza para enfrentar sus miedos y competir en la carrera de su vida o su familia lo perderá todo.

programme.title: Mary Shelley

programme.title: Love & Other Drugs
programme.desc: Maggie y Jamie comienzan una relación que los enfrenta a una enfermedad y a la droga del amor.

programme.title: Un pedacito de cielo
programme.desc: Marley (Kate Hudson) es una mujer joven que descubre que se está muriendo de cáncer, pero cuando de forma inesperada se enamora de su médico (Gael García Bernal), la amenaza de caer en el amor es más aterradora que la muerte.

programme.title: Hometown Remedy
programme.desc: Una cirujana regresa a casa para la celebración de la alcaldía de su padre y encuentra un romance con el compasivo médico soltero de la ciudad.

programme.title: Secrets at the Lake
programme.desc: Un año después de que su marido y sus dos hijos fallecieran en un accidente de coche, Megan Myers alquila su casa.

programme.title: The Unsaid

programme.title: The Wrong Husband

programme.title: De la Misma SangreThrillers
programme.desc: Un policía con gran integridad se ve envuelto en muchos problemas por culpa de su hermano quien trabaja para un poderoso narcotraficante y aunque trata de ocultar el parentesco con su hermano esto no es posible.

programme.title: Deportados

programme.title: Desaparecidos

programme.title: Dos Gallos De Pelea

programme.title: Dos Gallos En Palenque

programme.title: El Ansia De Matar
programme.desc: Daniel y Raúl son dos hermanos con una relación estrecha, sin embargo, esto cambia con la muerte de su padre, pues al dar con el asesino Daniel decide quedarse en Durango para continuar con su vida de juego y Raúl se va a estudiar a otro estado.

programme.title: La Espada del Dragón

programme.title: Hand of Death
programme.desc: Dorian Tan Tao-liang, estudiante Shaolin, busca traidor Manchu que mató al abad. Jackie Chan, experto en lanzas, ayuda. Misión: proteger erudito de los Manchus.

programme.title: La Nueva Furia del Dragón

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager

programme.desc: Kes se comunica con astronautas ocampa y la Guardiana, quienes podrían tener el poder de enviar a la tripulación a casa.

programme.desc: El robo de un módulo del transportador por parte de fuerzas kazonianas empuja a Chakotay a un enfrentamiento explosivo con su expareja traidora, Seska.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager

programme.title: Heidi: Un árbol como refugio
programme.desc: Clara ya puede ponerse de pie sin ayuda de nadie. El señor Sesemann quiere adoptar a Heidi, Heidi se aterra de la situación pensando que ya nunca vovler a las montañas. El señor Sesseman entiende el miedo de Heidi y decide posponer la adopción.

programme.title: Heidi: El fantasma

programme.title: Heidi: La carta

programme.title: Heidi: De regreso en Dörfli

programme.title: Heidi: Una nueva cabra en el rebaño

programme.title: Heidi: La estatua rota

programme.title: Heidi: Prueba escolar

programme.title: Heidi: La búsqueda del tesoro

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Repasamos la historia del RPG de accion por excelencia

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Hoy hablaremos del juego de plataformas 2D por excelencia y su impresionante salto entre los 8 y 16 bits. Esta es la historia detras de Super Mario World

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos sobre la arriesgada apuesta de Gearbox Software que dio origen al genero Loot Shooter como lo conocemos. Esta es la historia de Borderlands.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: Te contamos la histroia de Super Metroid, un titulo de calibre legendario que estuvo 3 veces en el borde de la cancelacion.

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: La historia detrás de…
programme.desc: En los 90, nadie hubiera imaginado que Nintendo estuviera al frente del genero de peleas con el titulo con mayor presencia y mejores ventas en la industria de los videojuegos

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: La historia detrás de…

programme.title: Cybernet LT

programme.title: Cybernet LT

programme.title: Cybernet LT

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Life In Six Strings
programme.desc: El tres veces ganador del Grammy, Steve Vai, abre las puertas de su mundo creativo y comparte su filosofía sobre la música y la técnica.

programme.title: The Great Songwriters
programme.desc: El cantautor Steve Earle, ganador de varios premios Grammy, habla sobre el proceso de composición y su trayectoria musical, y también interpreta una selección de temas como "Copperhead Road" y "Goodbye".

programme.title: Norah Jones Plays Baloise Session 2023
programme.desc: Norah Jones ha alcanzado el estatus de celebridad mundial desde 2002. En ese año se lanzó su primer álbum, "Come Away with Me". Este disco le valió seis premios Grammy.

programme.title: Temples: Ground Control Paris
programme.desc: La aclamada banda Temples no solo está influenciada por el rock ácido de antaño, sino que está consumida por él. La banda británica ofrece una actuación excepcional en directo en Ground Control, París, para el lanzamiento de su nuevo álbum "Exotico".

programme.title: Video Killed the Radio Star
programme.desc: Una mirada a cómo se hicieron algunos de los videos más memorables de la legendaria banda de rock.

programme.title: Piratas
programme.desc: Un grupo de piratas y bandidos se unen para cazar a una ballena gris que se ha tragado el sello real

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Un robo a un banco entrelaza las vidas del director de la sucursal, un restaurador, una joven policía embarazada, un policía veterano, y una docena de personas. Vivirán varias horas en compañía de cuatro ladrones con perfiles muy diferentes.

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Una joven policía, da suministros a los rehenes, uno de los cuatro ladrones está enfermo y necesita insulina. El Comisionado acepta darle una dosis a cambio de un rehén. En el sótano, dos cómplices perforan una pared que da acceso a la bóveda.

programme.title: El Asalto
programme.desc: Alex accede a la bóveda, y a un botín de ocho millones de euros. Los rehenes siguen atados con sus ojos vendados. Los ladrones se preparan para evacuar el banco a través de los sótanos.

programme.title: Triple Amenaza
programme.desc: La hija de un multimillonario se convierte en el objetivo de un cartel criminal peligroso y eficiente. Con lo que no contaron fue que su protección se convertiría en tres mercenarios despiadados.

programme.title: Conspiración en la Escuela
programme.desc: En una escuela secundaria católica, un periodista de segundo año investiga un caso de exámenes SAT robados. Él cree que ha clavado al sospechoso y logró atrapar a la chica popular cuando se da cuenta de que está ocurriendo una conspiración más grande.

programme.title: La Seducción
programme.desc: El hilarante Steve Martin protagoniza esta historia oscura y cómica de un buen hombre en una mala situación. Con Helena Bonham Carter, Laura Dern y Scott Caan.

programme.title: La familia Bélier
programme.desc: En la familia Bélier todo el mundo es sordo, excepto Paula, de 16 años. Ella es esencial para sus padres como intérprete en el día a día, sobre todo para el funcionamiento de la granja de la familia.

programme.title: Shutter
programme.desc: Una pareja descubre una inquietante presencia en fotografías de un supuesto accidente.

programme.title: Pacto con el Diablo
programme.desc: En 1665, tras la muerte de su esposo, Grace Haverstock es injustamente acusada de brujería. Detenida por el inquisidor John Moorcroft, soporta torturas mientras lucha por su cordura y su inocencia.

programme.title: Oscuros Secretos Del Colegio
programme.desc: Camille, una joven que llega a la Academia Fairfield tras la muerte violenta y prematura de uno de los estudiantes.

programme.title: La Posesión de Mary
programme.desc: Una familia que pretende abrir un negocio de transporte compra un barco que encierra un terrorífico secreto en su interior. Por desgracia para ellos, éste sólo sale a la luz cuando el buque se encuentra mar adentro.

programme.title: Agora: la Caída del Imperio Romano
programme.desc: Drama histórico sobre un esclavo que se vuelve hacia la creciente ola del cristianismo con la esperanza de buscar la libertad mientras se enamora de su amante, la profesora de filosofía y matemáticas Hipatia de Alejandría.

programme.title: El Ilusionista
programme.desc: En Viena de 1900, Eisenheim cautiva con sus espectáculos de magia e ilusionismo. Sus poderes sobrenaturales llegan a oídos del príncipe heredero Leopold.Sospechando un fraude,Leopold encarga al inspector de policía Uhl que vigile de cerca al mago.

programme.title: La Partición
programme.desc: Después de la muerte de su padre, un neoyorquino regresa a Cape Cod para preparar la casa de su infancia para la venta. Con el novio de su padre todavía viviendo allí, chocan y negocian cómo recordar al hombre que ambos amaban.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Kane, después de lidiar con su propio estrés de posguerra, está llamado a ayudar a su compañero de guerra (Ryan Robbins) mientras sufre de P.T.S.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Elijah Kane y su equipo intentan romper un sindicato del crimen organizado conocido como Yakuza y difunden una situación de rehenes.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Kane y su equipo se propusieron acabar con el Yakuza de una vez por todas.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: El pasado Black Ops de Kane está causando incertidumbre en el futuro del equipo SIU.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Mientras Kane está lidiando con los insurgentes de su pasado, un grupo de rusos de alto nivel migró al puerto de Seattle con un nuevo producto para el mercado negro.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Elijah Kane está preparando a su equipo para que la corte condene a Nicoli Putin de asesinato cuando son emboscados por los hombres de Putin.

programme.title: Una familia peligrosa
programme.desc: Un jefe de la mafia y su familia son trasladados a un pueblo tranquilo en Francia bajo el programa de protección de testigos después de delatar a la mafia.

programme.title: Rambo 4
programme.desc: El veterano de Vietnam John Rambo ha sobrevivido a muchas pruebas terribles en su vida y desde entonces se ha retirado a una existencia simple y aislada en Tailandia, donde pasa su tiempo capturando serpientes para artistas locales.

programme.title: THE EXPENDABLES
programme.desc: En 'The Expendables' el trío de héroes de acción compuesto por Stallone, Statham y Li formarán parte de un comando de mercenarios que se infiltrarán en un país de Sudamérica y lucharán contra un un cruel dictador para liberar a la población.

programme.title: THE PERFECT GAME
programme.desc: Basado en una historia real. En 1957, un grupo de niños pobres de Monterrey, México, conmocionó al mundo al ganar 13 juegos seguidos y la Serie Mundial de Pequeñas Ligas en el único juego perfecto jamás lanzado en el Campeonato.

programme.title: Coraje para Ganar
programme.desc: Después de perder a su padre, una joven debe encontrar la fuerza para enfrentar sus miedos y competir en la carrera de su vida o su familia lo perderá todo.

programme.title: El Mágico Circo de Noel
programme.desc: Karo se escapa de casa porque sus padres, en disputa, quieren divorciarse. Viaja con sus amigos circenses Victor y Tonie del Circus Noël, quienes pueden participar inesperadamente en Cultura Nova, un importante festival de circo.

programme.title: Una Historia de Sirenas
programme.desc: Una niña de doce años se hace amiga de una peculiar sirena adolescente que es cualquier cosa menos mítica, y su amistad podría curar una antigua enemistad.

programme.title: Un pedacito de cielo
programme.desc: Marley (Kate Hudson) es una mujer joven que descubre que se está muriendo de cáncer, pero cuando de forma inesperada se enamora de su médico (Gael García Bernal), la amenaza de caer en el amor es más aterradora que la muerte.

programme.title: Hometown Remedy
programme.desc: Una cirujana regresa a casa para la celebración de la alcaldía de su padre y encuentra un romance con el compasivo médico soltero de la ciudad.

programme.title: Hampstead
programme.desc: Una viuda americana encuentra un amor inesperado con un hombre que vive salvajemente en Hampstead Heath cuando se enfrentan a los promotores que quieren destruir su casa.

programme.title: The Wrong Husband
programme.desc: Melanie y su esposo Derrick son un matrimonio perfecto. Jóvenes y atractivos, y con una brillante carrera profesional.

programme.title: The Wrong Mother
programme.desc: Una enfermera entra a trabajar en la casa de la mujer a quien donó sus óvulos, pero ahora quiere recuperar al hijo que su paciente concibió.

programme.title: The Wrong Nanny
programme.desc: Una mujer contrata a una abuela para que la ayude con sus hijos pequeños, solo para descubrir que la joven es la hija que dio en adopción al nacer.

programme.title: Desaparecidos
programme.desc: En 1835, los pobladores de un pequeño pueblo desaparecieron misteriosamente, ciento ochenta y tres años después, una pareja de científicos descubre algunas pistas que podrían llevarlos a revelar las causas de este extraño suceso.

programme.title: Doble Personalidad
programme.desc: Un agente de la policía investiga la desaparición de varias mujeres, para ellos se infiltra en el mundo de la trata de mujeres y el juego clandestino, buscando salvar a al que podría ser la próxima víctima.

programme.title: El 24
programme.desc: Chema es un matón a sueldo muy famoso por los hombres que ha matado, tanto que ha sido apodado El tumbador, su ultimo encargo es un hombre llamado Manuel quien se metió con la amante de un importante capo.

programme.title: El Ansia De Matar
programme.desc: Daniel y Raúl son dos hermanos con una relación estrecha, sin embargo, esto cambia con la muerte de su padre, pues al dar con el asesino Daniel decide quedarse en Durango para continuar con su vida de juego y Raúl se va a estudiar a otro estado.

programme.title: El Hijo Del Diablo
programme.desc: Victor Rincón es un contrabandista que hace quemar el rancho costeño de un viejo que no ha querido venderselo a bajo precio. El hijo del diablo, inmune a las balas, mata a unos esbirros de Victor para devolver al viejo su dinero.

programme.title: El Hombre Propone
programme.desc: Historia narrada a traves de tres cuentos escritos por Jacha. La primera de ella es ¡venganza!: al pobre músico Anselmo le hacen creer que dirigira una orquesta por television. Cuando descubre el engaño toma una pistola y mata al bromista.

programme.title: La Nueva Furia del Dragón
programme.desc: Un joven se propone vengar la muerte de su abuelo y demostrar su dominio de las artes marciales.

programme.title: El Ejecutor
programme.desc: Maestro de artes marciales y luchador, Kung Wei vive en una humilde casa con su mujer, que está muy enferma, y Johnny, su hijo, que le adora y sigue sus enseñanzas. Kung Wei es «reclutado» en secreto por la policía para desarticular una banda de Hong Kong

programme.title: Rescate Sangriento
programme.desc: Un ganster ruso retirado, actualmente escritor de novelas, es tentado a volver a la vida criminal cuando descubre que su hija va a casarse con el hijo de su enemigo.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Blitz es un asesino en serie de Londres que está matando agentes de la policía. El inspector jefe Roberts y el sargento Brant, un duro, inflexible y políticamente incorrecto detective de la policía, se encargarán de intentar detener al psicópata.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager
programme.desc: Cuando Torres reactiva un robot humanoide, se involucra en una guerra entre enemigos robóticos.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager
programme.desc: Con la esperanza de fortalecer la posición estratégica de la Voyager en el cuadrante, Janeway busca aliarse con los kazon a regañadientes.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager
programme.desc: Paris hace historia cuando se convierte en la primera persona en cruzar el umbral transwarp, pero podría pagar el logro con su vida.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager
programme.desc: Al no poder encontrar un motivo lógico para un asesinato en la nave, Tuvok realiza una unión mental con el perpetrador, lo que despierta el instinto asesino de Tuvok.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager
programme.desc: Torres trabaja contra reloj para detener un misil autoguiado mortal con rumbo de colisión.

programme.title: Air Collision
programme.desc: Cuando una tormenta solar destruye el sistema de control de tráfico aéreo, Air Force One y un avión de pasajeros están bloqueados en un curso de colisión en los cielos sobre el medio oeste.

programme.title: Viaje A La Tumba Maldita
programme.desc: Hu Bayi y su equipo parten para ayudar a Shirley Yang a encontrar a su padre y se embarcan en una peligrosa aventura hacia la Ciudad Prohibida.

programme.title: Asaltantes De Tumbas
programme.desc: En este emocionante relato, el coronel Hu Bayi, Shirley Yang y Wang Kaixuan liberan inadvertidamente la “Maldición de la Niebla” mientras intentan erradicarla, lo que provoca la trágica muerte de inocentes entre la población local.

programme.title: Dos Locos en Escena
programme.desc: Durante el ensayo de una obra de teatro un actor pierde el conocimiento. Su compañero lo cree muerto y esconde el cuerpo en una caja. Capulina es el encargado de hacer la mudanza de las cajas y un juego de escondite se establece entre el y el “asesino.”

programme.title: El Camino de los Espantos
programme.desc: Capulina maneja un camión de turismo. Se pierde en la carretera y se detiene en una casa abandonada donde fantasmas y espantos tratan de alejar a los turistas.

programme.title: El Carita
programme.desc: Capulina es un solitario que no puede encontrar novia. Un día, por un hechizo amanece como todo un galán. Todas las chicas lo buscan pero el solo quiere lograr el amor de una, a la que por mucho tiempo ha amado en secreto.

programme.title: Crimen y deseo
programme.desc: Una joven intenta desesperadamente escapar de una vida sórdida de crimen y drogas en un pueblo minero de Kentucky. Cree que su mala suerte puede cambiar por fin cuando un agente del FBI la recluta como informante para un caso de alto perfil.

programme.title: Asesino a sueldo
programme.desc: Una confusión pone a Slevin en mitad de la guerra entre dos clanes mafiosos neoyorquinos, el que dirige El Rabino y el que comanda aquel al que llaman El Jefe. Slevin intentará escapar vivo de los gánsteres, los sicarios y la policía.

programme.title: Siervos de la guerra
programme.desc: Un detective experto colabora con una policía novata en la resolución del misterioso asesinato de un conocido especialista en trasplante de médula ósea.

programme.title: Max Steel
programme.desc: Max es un adolescente que acaba de mudarse a un nuevo pueblo y descubre que su cuerpo puede generar energía. Max conoce a Steel, un alienígena con el que combina fuerzas para crear a Max Steel, un superhéroe extraordinariamente poderoso.

programme.title: Contrarreloj
programme.desc: Rachel y Carla como grandes amigas deciden ir a divertirse a un bar. Ahí conocen a Travis, Rachel pasa la noche con él siendo infiel a su esposo. Al día siguiente, Travis le pide dinero a cambio de su silencio.

programme.title: Condena al Servicio
programme.desc: Sara por defensa personal tuvo que dispararle a su esposo, al llegar a corte, pensó que todo iba a ser muy fácil hasta que la sentenciaron por varios años en la cárcel.

programme.title: Los Ojos del Dragon

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Aang se siente inseguro cuando Katara y Sokka se encuentran con algo que les recuerda a casa. Por miedo a que sus amigos lo abandonen, Aang esconde un mensaje importante, lo cual conduce a más problemas.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender
programme.desc: Los niños llegan a la tribu Norte del Agua, donde Aang y Katara buscan a un Maestro de Agua. Mientras, Sokka se enamora de una princesa. Zhao planea un ataque y Zuko debe encontrar una manera de continuar su búsqueda del Avatar.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Oscuros Secretos Del Colegio

programme.title: Obsesión Del Pasado (2009)

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: El equipo de Kane se une a la CIA en Vancouver para atrapar al abogado que golpeó su precinto y espera que su captura conduzca al autor intelectual del ataque.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: Justicia verdadera
programme.desc: Kane y su equipo rastrean a un conocido traficante de órganos, que escapó del ataque y promete llevar a Kane un paso más cerca de The Ghost.

programme.title: Justicia verdadera

programme.title: THE EXPENDABLES

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: En Nueva York, el experimentado ladrón de arte, Keith Ripley, invita al audaz ladrón de Miami, Gabriel Martin, a unirse a él.

programme.title: 24 horas para vivir
programme.desc: Un asesino profesional muere durante uno de sus trabajos, pero es devuelto a la vida por un día para cumplir una importante misión.

programme.title: Una Historia de Sirenas
programme.desc: Una niña de doce años se hace amiga de una peculiar sirena adolescente que es cualquier cosa menos mítica, y su amistad podría curar una antigua enemistad.

programme.title: Un hombre extraordinario
programme.desc: Una aldea espera con ilusión la llegada de un hacedor de milagros. Pero el humilde viajero que aparece no es lo que esperaban. Sin embargo, los milagros pueden ocurrir en todas sus formas y tamaños.

programme.title: Meet Dave
programme.desc: Una nave espacial con forma humana tiene 48 horas para recuperar el orbe y arrojarlo al océano.

programme.title: Hampstead

programme.title: El Arribo de Conrado Sierra

programme.title: El Malvado Carabel

programme.title: El Puma

programme.title: El Rapto De Las Sabinas

programme.title: Peligro en la montaña

programme.title: Crime Story

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager

programme.title: El Dolor de Pagar la Renta

programme.title: Tres ladrones y un bebé

programme.title: Telaraña de Mentiras

programme.title: Voltea #pqtenamores

programme.desc: La vida de Yelina está en peligro cuando Horatio y el equipo de CSI trabajan en un caso para condenar a un rapero sospechoso de un tiroteo al estilo de Miami desde un auto en movimiento.

programme.title: CSI: Miami

programme.title: CSI: Miami

programme.desc: El ambiente de discoteca de Miami se vuelve mortal cuando el consumo de alcohol por parte de menores provoca un sangriento asesinato en un baño, Horatio y el equipo de CSI investigan.

programme.title: CSI: Miami

programme.title: CSI: Miami

programme.title: NCIS LT

programme.title: Rookie Blue LT

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Yu-Gi-Oh!

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¡El fútbol llegó a Cybernet! En el episodio de hoy conoceremos cómo fueron evolucionando los videojuegos de fútbol y cuáles han sido sus mejores series. ¿Cuál es su juego de fútbol favorito?

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¿Cuáles han sido los mejores juegos basados en una caricatura? Descúbrelo en el Top 10 del nuevo episodio de Cybernet. También les explicaremos en qué consiste el popular género llamado Roguelike.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Los deportes también pueden ser digitales y los esports ya rebasan en audiencia a muchas justas deportivas. En este episodio de Cybernet, conoceremos cuáles son los juegos competitivos más populares y qué se necesita para ser un jugador profesional.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Muchas de las franquicias más famosas de los videojuegos surgieron en las arcades, en el episodio de hoy de Cybernet conoceremos la historia de ellas. También haremos un recuento de varias franquicias que prácticamente están olvidadas.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Llegó el momento que estaban esperando en Cybernet. En el episodio de hoy tendremos una retrospectiva de la consola Nintendo 64, así como de una de las franquicias más famosas que surgieron en esa consola: Super Smash Bros.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: ¡Ay, caramba! El episodio de hoy de Cybernet se pinta de amarillo con una retrospectiva de los juegos de Los Simpsons. También analizaremos en qué consisten los famosos juegos estilo Battle Royale y recordaremos a los mejores reboots de la industria.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: El demonio anda suelto en Cybernet, así que decidimos traerles un especial de Devil May Cry. También les diremos qué juegos son prácticamente clones de otros títulos.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Tenemos un episodio muy especial de Cybernet. Hoy conoceremos la historia de Neo Geo y de sus mejores juegos. Además, nos acompañarán los integrantes del estudio mexicano Evoga, quienes realizaron junto a SNK el videojuego de Rage of the Dragons.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Desde una galaxia muy lejana, llega un episodio muy especial, que incluye una retrospectiva de los juegos de Star Wars. Nos reiremos con los juegos más graciosos y cómicos de la historia, y analizaremos el paso de las consolas portátiles de Sony.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: El simio más famoso llega a Cybernet con un especial de Donkey Kong Country, así que cuiden bien sus bananas. Además, ¿ustedes saben qué es real y qué no lo es? Esperemos que no estemos atrapados en la Realidad Virtual, por ello vemos la evolución del VR.

programme.title: Cybernet LT
programme.desc: Asegúrense de que el espía más famoso de los videojuegos no esté escondido detrás de ustedes o dentro de una caja de cartón. En el episodio de Cybernet de hoy, nos complace presentarles una retrospectiva de Metal Gear Solid.

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Avatar: The Last Airbender

programme.title: Kenan y Kel

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
programme.desc: Ansioso por saber qué le compraron sus padres como regalo de cumpleaños, Kenan se mete en su habitación y encuentra un paquete, pero Kel lo rompe por accidente. Ahora los chicos tienen que correr para reemplazar el regalo.

programme.title: Kenan y Kel
